tools.name: search_cruises
tools.description: Find cruise recommendations and deals on CruiseHops by destination, departure port, dates, cabin and budget. Coverage includes captured sailings from Carnival Cruise Line, Royal Caribbean International, MSC Cruises, Norwegian Cruise Line, Celebrity Cruises, Princess Cruises, Holland America Line, Co

tools.name: suggest_cruise_terms
tools.description: Suggest matching ship, port, destination and cruise line names, including suffix words. Returns stable term IDs for search filters.

tools.name: list_departures
tools.description: List bounded, paginated unique dated sailings for a public ship-itinerary group ID. Preserves cabin/date filters; older event-specific group IDs remain supported.

tools.name: get_sailing
tools.description: Explore a CruiseHops sailing page: itinerary, cabin fares, price-history context and links to the website and fare provider. Research only; no widget. Read sailing itinerary, cabin-filtered offers and booking URLs. Amenities and media are omitted by default; request them explicitly only when needed.

tools.name: get_cabin_price_history
tools.description: Read lowest returned cabin prices across promotions. Use headlinePriceHistory[].id from get_sailing as seriesKey. Fare and category changes are explicit; missing observations do not establish unavailability.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Read one exact captured offer context's price history. contextKey is required from get_sailing offers. Never blends cabins, fares, markets, guest counts or events. Dates select overlapping captured observation spans; maxPoints retains the latest points.

tools.name: present_cruises
tools.description: Present the final shortlist of one to three selected sailings in ONE interactive widget. Call once after research, preserving exact offer IDs, cabin classes and event selectors. Research tools do not render widgets. Do not repeat all widget details in prose.

tools.name: compare_sailings
tools.description: Compare two to four distinct sailings and optional exact offer IDs. Defaults to lowest current captured two-adult offer; occupancy is explicit per offer. No live or family quote.

tools.name: present_excursions
tools.description: Open ONE interactive port-experience browser when the user wants excursions, tours or activities. Omit portId to let the user choose a port without calling Viator. Supply a supported local portId and optional visit date and activity keywords q to show matching experiences. This makes a fresh on-dema

tools.name: list_excursion_ports
tools.description: List local cruise ports and whether excursion searches are supported. No Viator product request. Use the returned port ID for find_port_excursions.

tools.name: find_port_excursions
tools.description: Search Viator on demand only when the user asks for activities or excursions. Use a port ID from list_excursion_ports or get_sailing itinerary.portId. Pass the port visit date, not the cruise departure date. Optional q searches activity keywords such as snorkeling or food tours within that port; pre

tools.name: get_excursion
tools.description: Fetch details only for a Viator product the user selected from find_port_excursions. Returns allowed product content and an affiliate booking URL; no reviews, protected content or live availability. Verify meeting point, return timing and availability on Viator.
